thread:
Alex (support): FYI AcmeFinance is seeing a sustained spike of 504s for hosted inference since ~09:12 UTC. Customer reports SDK retry loop and double-billing on some requests. Sending initial logs.

Sam (support): Reported error pattern: a lot of streaming requests get `504 Gateway Timeout` from the gateway, SDK retries default backoff -> repeated attempts. They say it started after a large batched embed job (batch_size=128) yesterday night.

Alex (support): Attaching sanitized sample from their log: `2026-03-16T09:13:02Z client=acme id=abc123 route=/v1/generate status=504 upstream=nginx_conn_timeout`

Priya (eng): Can you paste a minimal repro or curl that triggers it? If it's a large-embed batch we might be hitting connection pool exhaustion + long tail token gen on some requests.

Sam (support): Repro steps customer provided: `python sdk` snippet: 
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=REDACTED)
resp = c.embeddings.create(model="open-emb-2", input=["..."]*128)
```
They said p95 latency jumps and then 504s for new requests.

Mike (SRE): I'm seeing a pattern in ingress: upstream keepalive slots saturated when many long-lived streaming calls run concurrently. Backend pods report steady CPU, but nginx upstream queue grows and connections time out. Looks like connection reuse isn't being effective due to mixed short/long requests.

Priya (eng): Can you dump `netstat`/conn stats on the affected gateway nodes and also the `haproxy/nginx` backlog metrics? Also ask customer for exact SDK version. We had a change to the SDK retry defaults last month that can aggravate duplicate billing if retries are aggressive.

Alex (support): Customer using `redwood-sdk==0.8.1`. They said they saw ~8 retries for some calls.

Mike (SRE): Mitigation proposal (short term): 1) Enable a conservative circuit-breaker on the gateway for the embedding route (503/504 -> fail fast) 2) Apply per-client connection limit and queue shaping 3) Ask customer to reduce batch_size to 32 for their overnight job. I'll prepare a rollbackable gateway change.

Chris (platform): I'll open a canary to stage in us-west-2 with `circuit_breaker: true` for `/v1/embeddings` and `max_conns_per_client: 50`. Deploy window: immediate, canary for 10 minutes, then roll to 3 nodes. Running health checks during canary.

Priya (eng): Long-term fix: runtime should prioritize short control-plane and small inference calls ahead of giant batch embeddings. Also we need to improve SDK to expose `Retry-After` and smarter incremental backoff when the gateway signals overload. I'll draft a PR to: 1) update SDK backoff policy, 2) gate retry count to 3 for streaming/generate endpoints.

Sam (support): Customer update prepared: "We're applying temporary gateway throttles and request shaping; recommend reducing embedding batch sizes to 32. We'll follow up with a permanent SDK and platform change. ETA for next update in 45m." :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Deployed canary config `cb-embeddings-2026-03-16` to 3/3 nodes in us-west-2 (canary). Config diff: `+circuit_breaker(true), +max_conns_per_client=50, +queue_limit=200`

Mike (SRE): After canary we saw 70% reduction in 504s on that route and ingress queue depth dropped to normal. Telemetry: inbound concurrency for embeddings dropped and keepalive reuse improved. I think the gateway change mitigated immediate symptom.

Priya (eng): Followups: 1) Backport SDK change to patch release (0.8.x) to reduce default retries and respect `Retry-After` header. 2) Add runtime admission control to deprioritize very large batches when node busy. 3) Postmortem + customer-facing RCA in 24h.

Alex (support): Customer acknowledged mitigation and will re-run their job at smaller batch sizes. They asked about credits for duplicate charges — billing to follow up. Marking thread as monitoring for next 24h.

Sam (support): I'll file a billing ticket and keep them updated. Closing the urgent escalation, tracking follow-ups in #postmortems.

Chris (platform): Saved config: `cb-embeddings-2026-03-16` -> will schedule autoscaler tweak to honor concurrent stream limits.

Priya (eng): PR opened: redwood/sdk#452 (patch: limit retries for streaming -> 3, add respect_retry_after=true). Will request review.

Mike (SRE): TL;DR root cause hypothesis: gateway connection pool exhaustion caused by mix of large batched embedding jobs (long-tail work) + aggressive SDK retries; gateway queued connections hit timeout leading to 504 and retry storms. Fixes: gateway shaping + SDK backoff + runtime admission control.

Alex (support): Thanks team. I'll maintain customer comms and post the RCA once ready. :white_check_mark:
